Four comments

Donald McLean of Lewis

This, of course, is a 6/8 pipe march and not a jig, although it has been played as a jig in the past, particularly in Cape Breton.

It was written by P/M Donald McLeod and has become one of the pipe standards. You can read more about Donald McLeod here:

http://www.footstompin.com/articles/celtic_music_heroes/obj54567

↳ Posted by Alistair Cassidy on June 14th, 2007.

Donald McLean Of Lewis, X:4

Cracking version that I also had from a couple of pipers around Aberdeen, once upon a time. Taken from Volume 3 of Ceol na Fidhle, Highland Tunes for the Fiddle by Christine Martin.

↳ Posted by Matt Leavey on September 27th, 2018.
